'''Ben Daria''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Williston Park tournament (11 November)]] on 11 November 2000 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]], according to Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1459">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-14-williston-park-ny-11-11-00-im-koreand1459/ williston-park-ny-11-11-00-im-korean], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 14 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-14-williston-park-ny-11-11-00-im-koreand1459/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
